decisions.reason: Premium support builds directly on the firm's existing service operations and expert technical know-how, so it can interpret results and improve the offering.
The version management tool leverages the firm's software development and tooling knowledge, allowing it to learn from early results and refine the product.
The data processing contract tool lies outside the firm's technical hosting and support knowledge, limiting its ability to assimilate legal/compliance feedback and improve the product.
Scalable hosting for agencies is closely aligned with the firm's core hosting infrastructure and agency-focused direction, making it easy to interpret results and apply improvements.
